title: You Fail Dry Four-Card Logic, Yet Your Brain Catches Free-Riders Instantly
description:
You think smart adults solve simple logic cards every time! Yet eighty percent fail until someone cheats a group rule! This is the true story of the Stanford four-card cheater test. Here is what went wrong with textbook human logic theories.
